title: Instrument history
description: What the agent service answers for GET /v1/quotes/{symbol}/history?from=YYYY-MM-DD. Deterministic, no model. It is the engine's price history and its trading calendar at once: an outcome is measured by counting bars, and a day with no bar is a day the market was shut. Bounded in practice by how much history the provider fetches, which is two years.

bars.description: Oldest first, one entry per day the market was open. An empty array is a valid answer: it means nothing has traded since the date asked about, which the engine reads as a horizon that has not passed.

instrument.description: Echoed from the request rather than from the provider's response, so the symbol in an answer is always one that passed validation.

bar.description: One day's close, and only the close: it is all an outcome is measured on.
